goal: Establish the baseline of the existing VMware homelab network, identify virtual network connections and IP addressing, examine routing and DNS behavior within the lab, identify one genuine networking issue or discrepancy, and establish the foundation for the segmented enterprise network.
definition_of_done: Existing virtual network topology documented, NS-DC01 network configuration identified, IP addressing and routing understood, DNS resolution tested, connectivity between relevant lab systems assessed, one real issue investigated if present, findings and next steps documented.
dependencies: VMware Workstation available, existing Windows Server 2025 VM NS-DC01 accessible, administrative access to the relevant guest operating systems, current virtual network configuration available for inspection, no network modifications until the existing topology is understood.
tech_context: VMware Workstation, Windows Server 2025, NS-DC01, Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, domain northstar.local, PowerShell networking tools, existing virtual network adapters and virtual switches, Project 2 focus on routing, network services, segmentation, traffic analysis, and troubleshooting.
